description: Capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRPLib Set P). Single depot, capacity constraint, EUC_2D distances; the objective is to minimize total travel distance. Proxy fitness = 3000 - total_distance.

chromosome_encoding.content: Full permutation of customer ids (1-indexed, depot excluded), length = number of customers
chromosome_encoding.decoding: Greedy split: accumulate demands along the permutation, open a new route on capacity overflow

task_constraints.capacity: Sum of customer demands on each route ≤ capacity(Q)
task_constraints.depot: All routes start and end at the single depot (id=1)
task_constraints.visit: Each customer is visited exactly once by one vehicle

fields.distance_matrix: Precomputed n×n integer distance matrix, index = id-1
fields.optimal: Best known value published by CVRPLib (used only for reporting the gap, not involved in the algorithm)

3_objective_direction.note: CVRP is a minimization problem. The pipeline compares by 'maximization', so a proxy is used: best_fitness = FITNESS_LARGE(3000) - total_distance

4_objective_function.formula: minimize total_distance = Σ route_distance; route_distance = d(depot,first)+Σ d(i,i+1)+d(last,depot)
4_objective_function.proxy_fitness: best_fitness = 3000 - total_distance (maximization semantics, aligned with pipeline comparison/sorting/barrier)

total_distance.description: Sum of route distances over all routes, each route including the round trip to the depot

route_distance.description: Single route: accumulated distance along depot→first customer→…→last customer→depot
